title: La Cava del Tequila | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: La Cava del Tequila Located in World Showcase at EPCOT Imbibe “the essence of Mexico” with over 200 tequilas, top-shelf cocktails, Mexican beer and wine. Take off with a tequila flight or a wild passion fruit margarita. Light snacks such as guacamole and queso with corn chips are served.View Menu Mexican Bar-Lounge Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Operating Hours – 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM Valid admission required. A theme park reservation may be required based on admission type. An Important Message Valid admission required.
